findings.detail: Encoded-scheme URI resolve rejects malformed scheme rather than returning inertoutput; assertions now require exact malformed-scheme error.
Bare suffix option interprets authority and preserves malformed input; corrected scenario explicitly selects scheme x/noauthority before proving first-segment colon escape.
Baseline compressed-child generic failure could count timeout as advisory reproduction; acceptance now requires native exit1 and precise decoder errorcode.

verdict: Eligible for actual native verification; no remaining introduced blocking source finding in reviewed proposal. No final native/merge acceptance.
